Messages.Author: Kevin M.
Messages.Body:
LSJ,

In 6.1.5, it states "When an ally loses his last life counter, he is
burned." Does this mean that allies are *immediately* burned when they
lose their last life counter, i.e. the Succubus cannot burn all her life
to bleed you for that much?

Kevin J. Mergen, Prince of Madison, WI
